title: Google Cloud CEO confirms a new Gemini version coming very soon
summary: In a podcast interview, the Google Cloud CEO said a new version of Gemini is coming very soon and that internal benchmarks make Google confident in its performance. The transcript speculates Gemini 3.5 or an early Gemini 4 could be announced at Google I/O 21 days later.

research.notes: Source: Matthew Berman podcast interview cited in transcript.
